stages: Webhook name/constructor_name is caller supplied; optional account and message data are parsed from JSON/form without origin check.
Queue stores event/account/conversions_name; async trigger sends x-job-secret to process-queue.
Job authenticates by x-job-secret or secret query, or Bearer CRON_SECRET; this protects the worker route only.
Processor independently derives clientScope from event receiver fields with conversionsName fallback; this is a functional dedupe scope, not verified tenant identity.
Enrichment can select credentials/configuration by client name. Validate caller-to-tenant binding before enqueue/enrichment, not merely before outbound signing.
Shared client targets configured CONVERSIONS_BASE_URL plus query name and sends existing LEAD/PURCHASE JSON.
Reconciliation authenticates and counts missing event IDs; it does not enqueue or resend them. Existing errors/requeue/DLQ behavior must not change.
kommoTrace.requiredOriginValidation: Accredit the actual provider's supported authentication. Bind the verified integration identity to an approved account/channel and tenant on the server. Cross-check the legacy query, never trust query/account/request ID as proof. HMAC or a header credential must not be assumed supported. Preserve clientScope and business payload.
